narrative.overview:
The app is set like the routine page of a 1970s iron-game magazine printed in two inks. Condensed gothic capitals name the lift, the set itself is a headline numeral, and 1px rules do the structural work that cards and shadows do in a generic dashboard. The page is dense and ruled, read from a bench across the room in dim light: big numerals, high contrast, thumb-reachable bars.

There are two printings of the same page. **Ink** (default) is newsprint-coloured type on a warm near-black ground for the dim garage; **Newsprint** (`body.light-theme`) is near-black type on warm paper for bright rooms. Both share one red ink as the only accent. Every surface reads the semantic tokens (`--bg`, `--surface`, `--sunk`, `--line`, `--line-strong`, `--fg`, `--fg-muted`, `--accent`, `--on-accent`, `--pr`, `--scrim`) resolved on `body`, so a component written once prints correctly in both.

Motion is limited: completing a set wipes its line from ink to paper, left to right, and sheets rise or dock in. Everything else is an instant colour change. Reduced motion collapses all of it.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks: one press red on warm ink or warm paper; yellow is a spot colour for PRs only.
League Gothic caps for names, Barlow Condensed tabular numerals for figures, Barlow for running UI text.
Square corners (2px); lists are ruled, not carded.
Flat page; only floating layers cast a shadow.
Signature move: a done set's check square reverses to paper as a raised-ink band wipes across its line.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Red is the only accent. It marks the current thing (today, the next set, the active tab, the primary action) or a destructive thing. Never add a second accent hue to the chrome.

rules.name: The Spot Colour Rule
rules.body: Category and superset colours appear only as a small solid square swatch (10 to 12px) beside neutral text. They never tint a row, a chip fill, a border or a label. Yellow appears only on the PR tag.

rules.name: The Theme Through Tokens Rule
rules.body: Components read the semantic names (`--bg`, `--fg`, `--accent`...), never the raw Ink hexes, so Newsprint follows for free. A literal colour in a component is drift.

rules.name: The Caps Name the Lift Rule
rules.body: League Gothic in uppercase is for names: the date, page, exercise, routine, day, sheet. It never sets sentences, metadata or ordinary buttons; the one action that earns it is the large red action bar.

rules.name: The Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every figure a lifter reads (weight, reps, time, counts) is Barlow Condensed with tabular numerals. The next set's value is solid; later planned sets are outlined (1.2px text stroke) until they come up.

rules.name: The Data Label Rule
rules.body: Small condensed caps labels carry data: a sequence number (SET 2, DAY 1), a date, a count, a status ("Up next"), a nav group. They never carry a tagline or a decorative category over a heading.

rules.name: The Ruled List Rule
rules.body: Lists are rows divided by 1px `--line` rules, opened by a 2px `--fg` rule (set lines, weigh-ins, settings, page headers, routine identity, Body figures). Do not wrap list rows in individual cards.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Nothing that scrolls with the page casts a shadow. Cards, rows, buttons and inputs are flat; `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md` and `--shadow-glow` are intentionally `none`. No glass, no backdrop blur.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Corners are 2px or 0. Nothing on-system is pill-shaped or softly rounded.

rules.name: The Reversal Rule
rules.body: Done is shown by reversing the check square to paper and darkening the line to raised ink, never by a green tick, strikethrough, or a paper band across the row: a finished day must stay dark. It is the only animated state change on the page.

dos: **Do** read colours through the semantic tokens on `body` (`--bg`, `--surface`, `--sunk`, `--line`, `--fg`, `--fg-muted`, `--accent`, `--on-accent`, `--pr`) so both Ink and Newsprint print correctly.
**Do** set names in League Gothic caps and every figure in Barlow Condensed tabular numerals, sized from the 13 / 16 / 22 / 34 / 52 ramp.
**Do** build lists as ruled rows: a 2px `--fg` rule above, 1px `--line` between.
**Do** keep corners at 2px (`--radius`) or square, and touch targets at 44px or more.
**Do** mark the current item with red: the date band, the next set label, the active tab bar, the next day's top bar.
**Do** show completion by reversal, as the set line and selected segment do.
**Do** use the solid-fill background-image wipe for the set line; it is a mechanism for one flat colour, not a gradient.
**Do** give destructive actions an Undo toast.
donts: **Don't** put shadows on anything that scrolls with the page; only sheets, docked panels, the drawer, the toast, the overflow menu and the phone action bar float.
**Don't** use visible colour gradients, glass or backdrop blur.
**Don't** tint rows, chips or borders with category or superset colours; use a square swatch beside neutral text.
**Don't** use yellow for anything but the PR tag, or a second accent hue in the chrome.
**Don't** use pill shapes or radii above 2px on new surfaces.
**Don't** put a small caps label above a heading unless it carries data (a date, a sequence number, a count, a status).
**Don't** hardcode `rgba(255,255,255,…)` tints; they vanish on Newsprint. Use `color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg) N%, transparent)`.
**Don't** restyle the Calendar month view; it is owner-protected and keeps its own shapes while reading the tokens.
